column1: # The named speculation policies a models.tsv row selects through its
# speculation_profile field. A named profile keeps the model registry from
# growing one column per speculative-decoding option: a later admitted
# mechanism adds a row here and reaches every checkpoint that names it.
# id names the profile. spec_type is the llama-server --spec-type value, and
# `none` emits no speculation argument at all rather than an explicit off,
# because an absent key is what leaves a child on the ordinary decode path.
# draft_n_max and draft_p_min are the --spec-draft-n-max and --spec-draft-p-min
# values, `-` where the profile states none. backend_sampling is the
# --spec-backend-sampling value. evidence is the repository-relative record
# that admitted the profile, `-` for the profile that runs nothing.
# A profile naming a spec_type other than `none` requires the row selecting it
# to carry mtp_layers of 1 or more, because the multi-token-prediction context
# is built against the target model's own appended block: a checkpoint without
# one refuses to load rather than falling back, which is what took every
# fine-tune out of the roster while speculation was set globally.
